verdict.rationale: Unit is a financial infrastructure platform, so a rules or automation engine is a fair axis to judge, but the pack documents no user-definable rules that trigger actions on events. The Webhook Events page (title only) is a developer building block for constructing automations externally, not a rules capability. Configurable card controls and automated lending/repayment flows are adjacent features, not event-triggered rules a user can define.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
